blogs.title: Finetuning Giant Language Models on a Single GPU: The QLoRA Breakthrough
blogs.description: An introductory post that explains how QLoRA makes it possible to finetune massive models like LLaMA‑65B using just one 48 GB GPU. It breaks down the memory challenges of traditional 16‑bit finetuning, introduces the concept of quantization‑aware back‑propagation, and shows why this matters for researchers and hobbyists.

blogs.title: Inside NF4: The 4‑Bit NormalFloat Data Type That Powers QLoRA
blogs.description: A deep‑dive into the new NF4 (NormalFloat) format. The article describes how NF4 is mathematically optimal for normally distributed weights, compares it with older 4‑bit formats (FP4, Int4), and illustrates the tangible performance gains seen on benchmark tasks.

blogs.title: Double Quantization & Paged Optimizers: Memory Hacks Behind 65B‑Parameter Finetuning
blogs.description: Explains the two engineering tricks QLoRA uses to shave off gigabytes of RAM: (a) Double Quantization of the per‑block scaling factors, and (b) Paged Optimizers that leverage NVIDIA unified memory. The post shows simple visualizations of memory usage before and after each technique.

blogs.title: LoRA Meets Quantization: Why Low‑Rank Adapters Are the Secret Sauce
blogs.description: Describes how LoRA adapters work, why they’re perfect for QLoRA’s frozen 4‑bit backbone, and how adding adapters to every transformer layer recovers full 16‑bit performance. Includes a step‑by‑step guide for setting up LoRA with QLoRA in Hugging Face Transformers.

blogs.title: From Benchmarks to Real Chatbots: Evaluating Guanaco Against ChatGPT
blogs.description: Shows how the authors measured Guanaco’s chatbot abilities using MMLU, Vicuna, and human/GPT‑4 Elo tournaments. The post discusses the surprising findings—data quality beats size, GPT‑4 can serve as a cheap evaluator, and why traditional benchmarks sometimes mislead.

blogs.title: Practical Guide: Fine‑tuning Your Own Instruction‑Tuned LLM with QLoRA
blogs.description: A hands‑on tutorial that walks readers through cloning the QLoRA repo, quantizing a base model, creating LoRA adapters, running a quick finetune on an open‑source instruction dataset, and deploying the resulting model on a consumer GPU or even a phone.

blogs.title: The Ethics of Democratizing LLM Finetuning: Opportunities and Risks
blogs.description: Explores the broader impact of making 65B‑parameter finetuning accessible. It covers privacy‑preserving on‑device training, potential misuse scenarios, bias mitigation observed in Guanaco, and best practices for responsible deployment.
